name: english
description: The English patch profile (2026-10-09): the proportional Latin text engine and every parser/label override of vwf-test.json, every text container (SERIFU, SPEAKTST, BUNKA, MASTER, TAIIKU, SHIAI) repacked from the translation sheets with an 80-entry DTE built over the whole English corpus, English name tables and the overlay string overrides. Build: python3 tools/patch/build_patched.py config/patch/english.json (or make build-patched PROFILE=config/patch/english.json); apply build/patch/english.ppf to Track 1 of the Rev 1 dump.
